findings.highlight: I can’t endure it at the very end.
findings.evidenceJa: 最後の最後で、耐えられなかった。
findings.governingReading: At the very last moment, he failed to hold out.
findings.explanation: A realized failure is recast as present inability, weakening the decision that follows.

findings.highlight: I gather my courage.
findings.evidenceJa: 萎えかけた手足を奮い立たせる。
findings.governingReading: He rouses his weakening limbs.
findings.explanation: A concrete act of forcing failing limbs back into action becomes abstract courage.

findings.highlight: die gallantly
findings.evidenceJa: 派手に散ってやろうじゃないか
findings.governingReading: go out spectacularly
findings.explanation: Shirou’s defiant image of making a spectacular end becomes a moralized gallant death.

findings.highlight: At the same time, something passes by me.
findings.evidenceJa: すれ違うように、何かが通り過ぎた。
findings.governingReading: Something passes him as though crossing by in the opposite direction.
findings.explanation: A spatial crossing relation becomes mere simultaneity.

findings.highlight: Looking like he saw something unexpected
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツは、最後に。
findings.governingReading: At the end—his final act—Gilgamesh…
findings.explanation: The narration’s marked final-act pause disappears before Gilgamesh releases the chain.

findings.highlight: Gilgamesh lets go of the chain.
findings.evidenceJa: 天の鎖を放していた。
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh releases the Chains of Heaven.
findings.explanation: The Noble Phantasm’s established name is reduced to a generic chain.

findings.highlight: the void shrinks and disappears
findings.evidenceJa: 孔は手の平ほどの大きさまで縮み、やがて消え去っていった。
findings.governingReading: The hole shrinks to the size of a palm and eventually vanishes.
findings.explanation: The visible intermediate size and gradual completion of the hole’s collapse disappear.

findings.highlight: A golden field that is now deserted.
findings.evidenceJa: 一面の荒野となった黄金の大地。
findings.governingReading: The golden earth has become a wasteland as far as the eye can see.
findings.explanation: Physical devastation is reduced to the field merely being deserted.

findings.highlight: like a wasteland he once walked on.
findings.evidenceJa: いつか見た荒野に似ていた。
findings.governingReading: resembled a wasteland he had once seen.
findings.explanation: The English invents that Archer physically walked upon the remembered wasteland.

findings.highlight: takes away his body’s form.
findings.evidenceJa: この時代に現れた彼の体を透かしていく。
findings.governingReading: makes the body with which he appeared in this age increasingly transparent.
findings.explanation: The specific visual dissolution into transparency becomes generic loss of bodily form.

findings.highlight: looks up at the knight.
findings.evidenceJa: 乱れた呼吸のまま騎士を見上げる。
findings.governingReading: looks up at the knight while her breathing remains ragged.
findings.explanation: Rin’s sustained physical exhaustion at the moment she reaches Archer disappears.

findings.highlight: his armor is cracked and torn.
findings.evidenceJa: その鎧もひび割れ、砕けている。
findings.governingReading: his armor too is cracked and shattered.
findings.explanation: Rigid armor shattering is rendered as though it were torn fabric.

findings.highlight: Standing there haughtily
findings.evidenceJa: 以前のまま、出会った時と変わらぬ尊大さで佇む
findings.governingReading: He stands with the same arrogance as before, unchanged from when they first met.
findings.explanation: The farewell’s explicit return to Archer’s first-meeting posture disappears.

findings.highlight: The rising sun is in the distance.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠くには夜明け。
findings.governingReading: Dawn lies in the distance.
findings.explanation: Dawn as a surrounding threshold is narrowed prematurely to the sun itself.

findings.highlight: A golden light is emerging from the horizon.
findings.evidenceJa: 黄金の日が昇っている。
findings.governingReading: A faint golden sun is rising on the horizon.
findings.explanation: The physical sun is reduced to nonspecific light.

findings.highlight: trusted her back to.
findings.evidenceJa: 背中を任せた協力者。
findings.governingReading: a partner to whom she entrusted her back
findings.explanation: The idiom of mutual combat trust becomes malformed English that obscures who entrusted what to whom.

findings.highlight: His body was disappearing
findings.evidenceJa: 現界などとうに不可能な体で
findings.governingReading: with a body for which continued manifestation had long since become impossible
findings.explanation: A body persisting far beyond its possible manifestation is reduced to ordinary ongoing disappearance.

findings.highlight: She looks up at the knight.
findings.evidenceJa: 上目遣いで騎士を見上げる。
findings.governingReading: She looks up at the knight from under her brows.
findings.explanation: Rin’s visibly sulky, upward glance disappears from their restored banter.

findings.highlight: The instant she wonders if he should really disappear
findings.evidenceJa: いいのか、と。
findings.governingReading: Is this all right?
findings.explanation: Rin’s first, broader challenge to Archer’s regretless acceptance disappears before the narrower question about vanishing.

findings.highlight: I am not qualified for that.
findings.evidenceJa: 私にその権利はないだろう。
findings.governingReading: I likely have no right to do that.
findings.explanation: Archer’s moral and contractual denial of a right becomes a question of personal qualification.

findings.highlight: his will is strong.
findings.evidenceJa: その意思は潔白だった。
findings.governingReading: his intention was pure and unclouded.
findings.explanation: The absence of lingering stain or ulterior attachment becomes generic strength of will.

findings.highlight: it’s not something that is solved
findings.evidenceJa: 与えられる物ではない
findings.governingReading: it is not something she could give him
findings.explanation: The limit is Rin’s inability to bestow Archer’s salvation; the English turns salvation into an impersonal problem-solving process.

findings.highlight: the girl always has to be a positive, indulgent realist.
findings.evidenceJa: とことん甘くなくては張り合いがない。
findings.governingReading: unless she is positive, realistic, and thoroughly unsparing, she is no challenge at all
findings.explanation: mirror moon reverses 甘くない, turning the demanding, unsentimental Rin Archer values into an indulgent one.

findings.highlight: “Please take care of me. I think you know, but I am unreliable. Please support me.”
findings.evidenceJa: 「私を頼む。知っての通り頼りないヤツだからな。君が、支えてやってくれ」
findings.governingReading: “I leave myself to you. As you know, he is unreliable. You support him.”
findings.explanation: The English makes Archer directly call his present self unreliable and ask Rin to support him, obscuring the deliberate split by which “myself” means Shirou.

findings.highlight: Those are words of parting.
findings.evidenceJa: この上ない別れの言葉だった。
findings.governingReading: They were the most complete parting words possible.
findings.explanation: The superlative finality of Archer entrusting Shirou to Rin disappears.

findings.highlight: engraving the girl’s smile into his memory
findings.evidenceJa: 少女の姿を記憶に留めた
findings.governingReading: committing the sight of the girl herself to memory
findings.explanation: The English invents the smile as the sole remembered object, narrowing Archer’s proud final memory of Rin’s entire presence.

findings.highlight: A breeze.
findings.evidenceJa: ざあ、という音。
findings.governingReading: A rushing “zaa” sound.
findings.explanation: An unassigned sound accompanying Archer’s dissolution is promoted into a literal breeze.

findings.highlight: the ground that the knight was standing on
findings.evidenceJa: 騎士が立っていた荒野
findings.governingReading: the wasteland where the knight had stood
findings.explanation: The repeated wasteland image linking Archer’s inner world and departure becomes generic ground.

findings.highlight: the boy laying on the ground.
findings.evidenceJa: 倒れた少年の下へ駆けていく。
findings.governingReading: the boy lying on the ground.
findings.explanation: The intransitive posture uses the transitive verb “laying.”

findings.highlight: was like that of the boy.
findings.evidenceJa: いつかの少年のようだった。
findings.governingReading: was like that of the boy from long ago
findings.explanation: The remembered temporal identity linking Archer’s final smile to his younger self disappears.
